admission_requirements: Root freezes context/operator/init/full training budget/comparison list/statistic/seed-split scope before any fit. Use full representative graph tasks and appropriate multiple official splits if available. No toy numerical pilot or outcome-driven hyperparameter sweep.
claim_under_test: Graph-conditioned private transformations provide ensemble-specific competence value during joint shared-backbone training.
conditioning_scope: One prespecified fixed label-free feature-free structural context c_v, with exact graph access/normalization/cost specified before root admission. Do not use TEST labels, outcome-chosen contexts, teacher states, or high/low-confidence error gates. Structural context identity remains undecided; no feature cache authored.
falsifiers: A capable same-information conditional single closes the served gap.
A common conditioner matches private conditioning.
Feature-only or constant conditioning explains the gain.
Served improvement accompanies meaningful private-member competence degradation.
The same-information I4 wins and no measured cost–risk advantage remains.
illustrative_attributed_operation: At affine site/member m/node v, y_m,v=W h_m,v + B_m[ g_m(c_v) elementwise(A_m h_m,v)] + b; g_m(c_v)=exp(RMSNorm(Theta_m c_v)); W is live/shared and A_m,B_m,Theta_m are private. This is a graph-context version of TopLoRA inside a TabLoRA-style joint ensemble, not claimed as new.
interpretation_if_positive: A bounded empirical sharing/conditioning result; still not a methodological novelty certificate or external confirmation. Root must choose an unused confirmation before broader claims.

mandatory_decisive_controls.purpose: Keep the already prioritized ordinaryBE and factorized-M1/four-loss controls; isolate conditional effects from factorized optimization.

Same structure and dynamic operator in M1/ordinary and four-loss training; add a total-parameter-matched single variant if exact allocation can be established. If this suffices, no ensemble-specific conditioning contribution.
Members retain private adapters but share g(c_v); match added parameter capacity separately. If equivalent, private structure-conditioned specialization is unnecessary.
Separate conditional graph information from additional rank/parameters and generic feature conditioning; dimensions/parameter budgets fixed before outcomes.

Same conditional member architecture, graph context, input cache and native training budget; independently initialized models each individually selected on VALID before pooling. Quality reference, not automatically equal-storage reference.

measurement: Served VALID accuracy and proper risk; member mean/worst risk and competence against same-information I4; native probability pooling; realized parameter/storage/runtime/peak-memory including conditioning and reusable cache; retain every closed contrast.
no_cell_count_or_runtime_promised: No executable/source/fit grid exists; admission and cost audit would precede it.
objective_and_serving: Complete native own CE for every member; native arithmetic probability pooling and native validation-only checkpoint selection. No pretrained I4 teacher or external deployment head. Joint shared backbone remains throughout.
stop_rule: A null/negative decisive comparison is recorded and the branch is held; do not tune through failed contrasts to manufacture a positive conclusion.
